context.passage:
NORTH CITY NEWS

Local shoe store thrives in digital age

NORTH CITY (October 18)-It is
uncommon for independent retailers to
stay viable long enough to celebrate their
sixtieth anniversary. One of these rare
businesses is Morro's Shoe Store, a
popular athletic footwear seller on
Twelfth Avenue owned by resident Stan
Morro. It has even thrived amid
competition from online retailers.

- [1] -. Mr. Morro's father, Patrick,
established the store after he moved from
Detmar Valley to North City. The elder
Morro had learned about the shoe
industry from working in several shoe
stores in Detmar Valley. After moving, he
opened his store in North City on Fortieth
Avenue. When the younger Morro took
over the business, he moved the shop to
its current location on Twelfth Avenue.

Stan Morro received a stroke of luck
when North University built a new

regional campus in the city. "Thanks to
the university's sports programs, demand
for athletic shoes really took off," he said.
"We also expanded our selection of
merchandise to offer shoes in all sizes
and styles." - [2] -. To keep up with
business trends, he launched an online
shop a few years ago. However, he noted
that most of his regular customers prefer
to visit the store and try on shoes for
themselves. He explained that online
shoppers get "satisfactory" results when
they order shoes made by the same brand
as the worn-out shoes they are replacing.
-()-.

Earlier in the month, Shoe Retailing
Horizons, an industry trade magazine,
named Morro's Shoe Store the third-best
retailer in the region. - [4] -.

Mr. Morro said that "attentive customer
service" is the key to his store's success.

| ISS.
